description: This source file implements the Monitor plugin for the WPEFramework, including API methods (restartlimits, resetstats, get_status), property registration, unregistration, and event signaling related to monitoring plugin statistics and actions.

classes.name: Monitor
classes.description: Class implementing monitoring functionalities, including API endpoints, property registration, and event signaling within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace.

methods.name: void RegisterAll()
methods.description: Registers the plugin's API endpoints and properties for monitoring statistics and controls.

methods.name: void UnregisterAll()
methods.description: Unregisters the plugin's API endpoints and properties.

methods.name: uint32_t endpoint_restartlimits(const RestartlimitsParamsData & params)
methods.description: Sets new restart limits for a plugin based on provided parameters.

methods.name: uint32_t endpoint_resetstats(const ResetstatsParamsData & params,InfoInfo & response)
methods.description: Resets memory and process statistics for a specified plugin.

methods.name: uint32_t get_status(const string & index,Core::JSON::ArrayType<InfoInfo> & response) const
methods.description: Retrieves memory and process statistics for a plugin or all watched plugins.

methods.name: void event_action(const string & callsign,const string & action,const string & reason)
methods.description: Signals an action taken by the monitor for a specific plugin.
